notes:
Round 1 is not very different from standard Reinhardt play. Hold corners, swing hammers, weave firestrikes, charge tanks off the map. 

The first power we get is  [Shield Stampede](item_0c4ef690-6472-48fe-9257-864c4381f584). This is an extremely versatile power that will assist us in all aspects of the game. It allows us to go for some riskier pins since we can't get blown up by  [Zenyatta](hero_3c4002ee-e694-48ed-9730-70fd48773317) and  [Soldier: 76](hero_e1ac7ef5-4648-4998-b8b0-9e3da3e60546)  during out charge, and also allows us to charge some heroes we normally can't, like  [Ana](hero_f1aee6cf-704f-455f-a100-ec882ebbe000) and   [Sigma](hero_646d9571-c40a-4403-b6c1-fb67adb6112d) when he has rock. When you're low health and shielding without a support to save you, you can counter-offensive charge without dropping shield. 

For items, we go plasma converter, weapon grease and heartbeat sensor. These items give Reinhardt the best round 1 power, but feel free to pick your favorites.

round_upgrades.notes: Best for when you are brawling/swinging consistently. Can be swapped for weapon power or ability power when you are diving/at range more.
Good for getting in damage whether you're brawling or diving
Extra movement speed to help close the distance on cowardly heroes!

notes:
We want to rush for  [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) this round if possible. This gives us damage, movement speed and sustain - most everything that we want. This item is pretty standard on Reinhardt, so not making any waves with this pick. If you only have 10k after round 2, I would sell green items to pick it up still. If you have less than 10k, buy  [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054) and  [Technoleech](item_cb7fd8bf-bdcc-439a-ad35-372f24a027a8), or just Aftermarket Firing Pin if you can only afford 1. Whenever I can't afford my main item, these two items are my go-to purchases.

Good situationals are  [Ironclad Cleats](item_afb5c28e-3980-4a7d-85be-785c32217c28),  [Boost Recycler](item_97a47dab-4554-4340-a9ef-f9424210e08b),  [Crusader Hydraulics](item_b64cee07-ca32-405d-987e-868b415bbc09) for heavy boop comps, Orisa/Sigma/Reinhardt machups, and if you're getting blown up quickly, respectively.

round_upgrades.notes: Core first item, sell to get it round 2 if you have to.
Best optional item, worth to sell weapon grease and heartbeat sensor to get this if you can afford it. Will slot this in the entire game with extra cash
Good optional item if you can't afford core items, I buy this after buying Aftermarket Firing Pin if I have cash still.
Has some value if the enemy Lucio is your worst nightmare, but typically I will just slot to one of the items above
Good against tanks that can cancel your charge as you can almost immediately charge again for cheeky pins, enemy team rarely expects it. Sell this once we get Dampener Grip next round.
Good at keeping you alive if you're getting absolutely mauled in a reaper/cassidy match. I only buy this if I have no choice, but is sometimes necessary

notes:
For powers, it's a toss-up between  [Feeling the Burn](item_256f9e9c-c332-42f2-83d9-ad0d47e23399),  [Impact Burst](item_01fa37d8-4355-4ec2-a9af-59bf030e2882), and  [Vroom Boom Boom](item_b016a02c-50bd-4010-91bb-661c1101ade7). The advice I will give is don't take Impact Burst against Dva or an Orisa with the reflect perk, and care for Genji's too. Vroom Boom Boom can help guarantee eliminations against tanky enemies you hit with your charge, but there is some ability power in this build so it's up to you. Feeling the Burn is great for brawling and helps killing squishies too by giving you that last tick of damage just as they run out of your reach. 

Big item here is  [Dampener Grip](item_451f8c81-1821-48a4-a980-ae1cebd61a85). This is where the build truly comes online. This gives us attack speed to brawl better and gives us more firestrikes and charges than we could ever need. Charge tanks off cooldown (ideally off the map) and weave in firestrikes as much as possible to maximize dps.

round_upgrades.notes: Our second core item, sell the rest of our green items to acquire if necessary. Gives us tons of firestrikes and charges while we can swing on enemies. This enhances our "brawler" playstyle and lets us deal tons of damage with hammer swings and abilities. We can use this to get charge back faster after counterpinning enemy Reinhardt, immediately charge after Orisa fortify blocks our first charge, and chase Dvas into our backline with a charge cooldown that now matches her boosters.
Buy if you have the cash

notes:
Our 3rd item can be mixed and matched a little, but my 2 choices are [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643) and [Three-tap Tommygun](item_39c5d2a4-1db0-444f-86d9-2a1e9a331429).

Phantasmic Flux gives great damage and sustain, especially since this build deals damage with weapons and abilities. It is typically my 3rd item choice, and then I will get Three-tap Tommygun 4th. 

Three-tap Tommygun will give you more damage than Phantasmic Flux, but you'll be left a little squishier. It's up to you to make the determination in game which you want first, and to play around with the setup yourself to see what works best for you.

round_upgrades.notes: Gives us damage and lifesteal for our dual weapon/ability playstyle. At this point you should very much notice being able to go into the enemy team, tearing them up, and living to tell the tale (although there is nothing wrong with dying with glory, haha.)

notes:
Rounds 5 and 7, we will get the power that we did not get in round 3, either  [Feeling the Burn](item_256f9e9c-c332-42f2-83d9-ad0d47e23399),  [Impact Burst](item_01fa37d8-4355-4ec2-a9af-59bf030e2882), or  [Vroom Boom Boom](item_b016a02c-50bd-4010-91bb-661c1101ade7). I would take Impact Burst at some point even if the enemy has a Dva/reflect Orisa as the damage is still valuable for securing kills when those abilities are down. Especially when against reflect Orisa and Genji, firestrike with EXTREME care for your teammates.

Buy  [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643) or  [Three-tap Tommygun](item_39c5d2a4-1db0-444f-86d9-2a1e9a331429), whichever you didn't get last round.

If you feel that you are satisfied with your damage and want to begin securing some better survivability, now is also a good time to begin slotting into tankier items. See notes on round 6 for some recommendations, with special shoutout to Lumerico Fusion Drive.

round_upgrades.notes: Tons of damage when utilizing abilities with our hammer (you know, what we've been doing the whole time). Don't worry about perfectly timing 1 ability for every 3 swings, you will be getting more than enough firestrikes and charges to keep this ability up most of the time (and if you're counting swings and firestrikes in your head, how are you supposed to focus on the match at hand? We must preserve our mental bandwidth).
Fantastic when paired with Crusader Hydraulics for big damage reduction
Best in slot cheap damage reduction item, possibly better than Aftermarket Firing Pin depending upon the game
One of our round 6 or 7 picks, but can be slotted in now as necessary. Gives you more time to make your lifesteal work, and gives your supports more time to keep you alive. Best in slot survival item
Great against damage dealers that can stack this item fast (shotguns, rapid fire soldiers, etc.) Probably my second choice for survivability after Nebula Conduit
A good generalist item. Actually makes you faster with your shield out, so a slightly offensive power as well.
Favorite tank item, we will be going this guaranteed after Three-tap Tommygun but I might take it sooner - see notes on next round for more info

notes:
Round 6 and 7, we have already secured our damage. Now, enemy Soldier's and Cassidy's and Reaper's and Freya's are getting their full damage items, and we need to secure our survivability against their now massive damage. I would also consider slotting these items in begging last round, depending on how oppressive the enemy DPS is becoming. 

My top pick is always  [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8). Every ability we cast now restores 50 armor over 2 seconds. As we are using a ton of abilities, this is essentially a second Gloomgauntlet but for our armor. 

After this, my top pick is probably  [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8). This item buys us time - time for our weapon and ability lifesteal to keep us up, and time for our supports to keep us healed. 

I have included other items I like in the optional items, but these two are my favorite- I will even take Lumerico before Three-tap Tommygun if I don't need attack speed as much

round_upgrades.notes: Great against enemies that stack it fast and keep it stacked (shotguns, fast-fire rate champions). Situationally better than Nebula Conduit
Great item - buys time for your lifesteal and healers to keep you alive - this is my last item most games
Solid sit on the point and survive item - if you have to turtle and your healers aren't that reliable or that powerful (Lucio Zenyatta I'm looking at you) then this will be better than Nebula Conduit
Another good item if your healers aren't pumping into you, worth consideration
Funny item that makes you walk faster with your shield out - not optimal in my opinion but not bad enough to not be included

Sometimes no matter how much survivability you build it's not going to matter - that's when you build this. This is a play-making item that lets you creatively turn the game on its head. If your team is banging their heads against a wall and you need that X factor, this is the item for you

notes:
Nothing new here, everything is pretty much wrapped up in the round 6 notes. 

Given that I am finally not flirting with the character limit, thank you for getting this far! I hope the build brings you as much success and joy as it has brought me! Please consider liking it and leaving a comment about whether you like it or not. I will continue updating the build as my own understanding of the game evolves and the meta shifts. Remember my fellow Crusaders, live with honor and die with glory! Catchphrase!!
